name: Edit text
description: Provides standard text editing and typography controls in a right-side extension tab. Selecting a text layer opens this extension so content, font, size, color, alignment, spacing, and clipboard behavior can be edited.

activation.name: Select text layer
activation.description: Opens or focuses the Edit Text extension when a text layer is selected. Double-clicking or pressing Enter places a caret for direct content editing while the extension displays formatting controls for the active selection.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Contains the editable text content of the selected text layer. Typing replaces the active selection or inserts at the caret, and line breaks remain editable like text in a conventional document editor.

fields.name: selection
fields.description: Stores the caret or selected character range inside the active text layer. Formatting commands apply only to the selected range; with no range selected they define formatting for newly typed text.

fields.name: clipboard
fields.description: Supports standard Cut, Copy, and Paste behavior. Copy places selected text and supported formatting on the clipboard; paste inserts compatible rich text or falls back to plain text without requiring a sidebar tool.

fields.name: font_family
fields.description: Selects the font family for the selected text or the current typing style. The control lists available fonts and may accept a font identified by the font-matching workflow.

fields.name: font_size_px
fields.description: Sets font size directly in pixels for selected text or newly typed text. The user can choose a preset, enter an exact value, or increment and decrement the current value.

fields.name: font_weight
fields.description: Sets the available font weight, such as Regular, Medium, SemiBold, or Bold, for the selected text.

fields.name: font_style
fields.description: Toggles typographic styles such as italic when the selected font family supports them.

fields.name: text_decoration
fields.description: Applies underline or strikethrough decoration to the selected text without rasterizing it.

fields.name: text_color
fields.description: Sets the foreground color of selected characters or newly typed text. The control supports visual color selection, exact color values, and sampling a color from the canvas.

fields.name: alignment
fields.description: Aligns text within its text box to the left, center, right, or justified edge. This changes paragraph layout rather than moving the text box itself.

fields.name: line_height
fields.description: Controls vertical distance between baselines for paragraphs in the selected text box. It may be expressed as a multiplier or an exact pixel value.

fields.name: letter_spacing_px
fields.description: Adjusts horizontal tracking between characters in the selected range or text layer.

fields.name: text_box
fields.description: Stores the editable text layer bounds in canvas coordinates. Dragging handles resizes the box; text reflows within it according to the current fitting behavior.

fields.name: overflow_behavior
fields.description: Determines what happens when content exceeds its text box: automatically grow the box, wrap and preserve the box, shrink text to fit, or allow visible overflow.

fields.name: undo_redo
fields.description: Provides standard undo and redo for content changes, formatting changes, paste operations, and text-box geometry changes as part of the editor history.

commands.name: cut
commands.description: Removes the selected text and places it on the clipboard.

commands.name: copy
commands.description: Copies selected text and compatible formatting to the clipboard without changing the layer.

commands.name: paste
commands.description: Inserts clipboard text at the caret or replaces the current selection, retaining compatible formatting where possible.

commands.name: select_all
commands.description: Selects all text in the active text layer when editing text; outside text-editing mode it selects editor objects according to the global editor behavior.

commands.name: undo
commands.description: Reverts the most recent editor transaction, including typing, formatting, paste, or geometry changes.

commands.name: redo
commands.description: Reapplies the most recently undone editor transaction.
